concept: A commuter hesitates at two opposing routes, visually expressing uncertainty about which way to go.

generation.description: At twilight, a contemplative young adult with a dark backpack stands on an elevated urban walkway, seen from behind with one hand near the chin, facing a signpost and two diverging ramps. The left route curves toward a warm, bustling skyline filled with golden lights and silhouetted commuters, while the cooler, quieter right path leads past trees toward a dimmer city and distant hills beneath a moody, cloud-streaked sky.
generation.notes: Generation tool returned an empty prompt field. Third distinct candidate accepted after rejecting a near-duplicate mountain crossroads and a desk scene with fake text/ambiguous emotion. Source 1536x1024 PNG, center crop x=256..1280 to 1024x1024, converted to WebP quality 86.

rights.notes: Original AI-generated visual; no third-party artwork supplied.

accessibility.altText: A commuter pauses beneath two opposing blank directional signs where an elevated city walkway splits into two different routes at dusk.

qc.notes: Inspected 1024px square crop and 100px thumbnail. Two contrasting directional arrows and diverging paths remain readable; no text, logos or obvious anatomical defects. Compared with all existing sidecar scenes: unlike mountain overlook portraits, indoor worry, exclusion, or rainy-window solitude. Earlier attempts rejected: (1) mountain sunset scene repeated existing composition; (2) indoor desk scene contained apparent pseudo-writing and conveyed general stress rather than competing choices.
